items.title: Is it real or AI?
items.summary: That was one video pair in one survey Veriff ran in February 2026. Across all 16 pictures and clips, Americans did about as well as random guessing. In that test, people knew to look for something wrong. While you scroll, you don't get that warning. You could share a clip, get angry about it, or buy what it's selling before you think to ask. What do you do to check a video before you trust it?
